summary: A paraglider crashed into Intuition Bowl on the north side of Peak 6 and could not move; Summit County Sheriff's Office deputies and the Summit County Rescue Group responded, requesting Flight for Life due to severe injuries and the crash location; helicopter crews landed near the subject
location: Intuition Bowl, north side of Peak 6
responding_agency: Summit County Sheriff's Office; Summit County Rescue Group; Flight for Life
notes: Date pinned from the article weekend sequence: the Quandary cliffed-out hiker call came just before 6:30 p.m. Saturday Oct 5, 2024 (id 1493); the paraglider assist was the second rescue that weekend, Sunday Oct 6 (2024-10-06, Sunday-verified). Dated source is a content mirror of the Summit Daily story (original not recovered); SCSO Justice Files blotter cross-anchors the Peak 6/Intuition Bowl lead. Inserted run 686.
